caption:
Toto loves a big spike, but lately his knees ache every time he lands.

Landing isn't just the knees. Bending your knees and hips together for a softer landing lets your hips and trunk share the load.

Hybi's Pilates prep: 10 bridges, a 30-second single-leg balance each side, and keep your knees from caving inwards as you land. Clinical Pilates can help build the trunk and hip control that jumping sports ask for.

Knee swelling or a giving-way feeling is worth an assessment first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios run clinical Pilates and can help. Book online via the link in bio
